```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath("."))
library(data.table); library(fixest); library(ggplot2); library(knitr)
# Re-run the analysis if the results are missing
if (!file.exists("output/results.rds") || !file.exists("output/results_extra.rds")) {
  source("R/01_build_panel.R"); source("R/02_analysis.R"); source("R/04_robustness_extra.R")
}
source("R/03_tables_figures.R")
res <- readRDS("output/results.rds")
ex <- readRDS("output/results_extra.rds")
```

This report re-creates every table and figure in the manuscript from the raw data in `data/raw`. The main sample has **`r res$n_main_metros` metropolitan areas** with at least three jurisdictions responding to the 2018 Wharton survey.

## Table 3. Annual panel: shift-share employment shock × regulation

```{r}
kable(t3, align = "lccrr", caption = paste(
  "Metro fixed effects, division-by-year effects, and 2013 log real income and college share interacted with year.",
  "Standard errors clustered by metro in parentheses. * p < 0.05; ** p < 0.01."))
```

First stage: a one-point increase in predicted employment growth raises actual private employment growth by
`r sprintf("%.2f", coef(res$first_stage)["D"])` points (standard error `r sprintf("%.2f", se(res$first_stage)["D"])`).

Long-difference robustness (burden >30%):

```{r}
kable(res$robustB[, .(Specification = specification, `W x regulation` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", WxR_b, WxR_se), N)],
      align = "lcr")
```

## Table 6. Additional robustness

Precision of the regulation interactions (90% confidence intervals and minimum detectable effects at 80% power):

```{r}
f3 <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x)
kable(ex$equiv_A[, .(Outcome = outcome, `D x regulation` = f3(b), SE = f3(se), `90% CI` = paste0("[", f3(ci90_lo), ", ", f3(ci90_hi), "]"), `MDE (80% power)` = f3(mde80))],
      align = "lcccc", caption = "Annual panel (Table 3 specification).")
kable(ex$equiv_B[, .(Outcome = outcome, `W x regulation` = f3(b), SE = f3(se), `90% CI` = paste0("[", f3(ci90_lo), ", ", f3(ci90_hi), "]"), `MDE (80% power)` = f3(mde80))],
      align = "lcccc", caption = "Long difference, 2019-2024 (Table 4 specification).")
```

Standard errors clustered by state:

```{r}
kable(ex$state_cluster[, .(Outcome = outcome, `D x regulation` = f3(DxR), `SE (metro)` = f3(se_metro), `SE (state)` = f3(se_state), `p (state)` = f3(p_state))], align = "lcccc")
```

Shift-share sector weights for the burden >30% interaction (five largest):

```{r}
kable(head(ex$sectors$burden30$weights, 5)[, .(Sector = sector, Weight = f3(weight), `Sector estimate` = f3(beta_k))], align = "lcc")
```

Pre-trend tests in the remote-work event study and the Rambachan-Roth sensitivity analysis (average 2021-2024 effect on burden >30%):

```{r}
kable(fread(file.path("output", "tables", "table6f_pretrend_tests.csv"))[, lapply(.SD, function(x) if (is.numeric(x)) round(x, 3) else x)])
kable(ex$honestdid[, .(Method = method, Mbar, `Lower bound` = f3(lb), `Upper bound` = f3(ub))], align = "lccc")
```
